description: long lines indicating OCR-like noise (median > 500 chars)
content:
# Document with Long Lines

This document has lines that are extremely long, which is characteristic of OCR output where line breaks are missing or a PDF was converted without proper line wrapping. Each paragraph is a single very long line that exceeds the threshold for OCR noise detection making it a candidate for review before ingestion because the chunking quality may be degraded due to the lack of natural break points in the text which would normally allow the chunker to produce well-sized segments of appropriate length for retrieval purposes and the model context window size we target.

A second very long line appears here as well continuing the same pattern of missing line breaks and excessive line lengths that would be flagged as suspicious in a well-formatted document with normal paragraph structure and typical line widths of around eighty characters per line as is standard in most well-formatted text documents including proposals, runbooks, and architecture documents in this codebase.
